;! w16 MAIN.CPL WINDOWS/SYSTEM/MAIN.CPL
;! survive
;! ini WINDOWS/CONTROL.INI color schemes:,FFFFFF,FFFFFF,0,FFFFFF,0,800000,FFFFFF,FFFFFF,C0C0C0,C0C0C0,0,C0C0C0,C0C0C0,808080,0,C0C0C0,800000,FFFFFF,0,FFFFFF
; A colour scheme name of 450 characters (a hand-edited CONTROL.INI; cpl
; audit H2): 3.1's Color applet dies as it opens, w16's lists it; chosen
; (the last), then Cancel (nothing written)
blinktime 65535
run CONTROL.EXE COLOR
wait 4000
alt s
wait 300
key 23
wait 500
snap C0.BMP
key 1B
wait 2000
